Go to Bill Details and export the bill to view token usage.

Text generation is billed by the number of tokens for input and output.

Image generation is billed by the number of images successfully generated.

Video generation is billed by the number of video seconds successfully generated.

Free-quota data displayed in the console may be delayed.

Native generation fields include usage.input_tokens and usage.output_tokens. Detailed fields are usage.input_tokens_details.text_tokens, usage.input_tokens_details.image_tokens, usage.input_tokens_details.video_tokens, usage.output_tokens_details.text_tokens, usage.output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, and usage.output_tokens_details.audio_tokens. Some models instead expose top-level usage.image_tokens, usage.video_tokens, or usage.audio_tokens. Cache fields are usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens and usage.prompt_tokens_details.cache_creation.cache_creation_input_tokens plus usage.prompt_tokens_details.cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens. Streaming and non-streaming responses use the same usage fields. Cache creation fields are absent when explicit caching is not used. Requests may set parameters.enable_thinking.

Image results expose usage.image_count, usage.width, usage.height, and usage.size.

Video results expose usage.video_duration, usage.duration, usage.input_video_duration, usage.output_video_duration, usage.SR, usage.size, and usage.video_count. Requests may set prompt_extend.

TTS results expose usage.characters, usage.input_tokens consumed by the input text, and usage.output_tokens consumed by the output audio. Music results expose usage.duration.

ASR results may expose usage.duration or usage.seconds. Streaming ASR sentence_end events expose payload.usage.duration.
